# Extension author contract

<!-- Generated by packages/ui-kit-system/scripts/gen-tokens.ts. Run `pnpm --filter @conciv/ui-kit-system gen:tokens` after editing a skin. -->

Extensions are components inside the widget's surface, not owners of its look. Style exclusively through the tokens and utilities below and your extension renders correctly under every skin and colour scheme with no per-skin work.

There is no per-extension theme override. If you need a bespoke colour, derive it locally from a public token:

```css
.my-extension-card {
  --my-card-tint: color-mix(in oklch, var(--chat-accent) 12%, transparent);
  background: var(--my-card-tint);
  border: 1px solid var(--chat-line);
  border-radius: var(--chat-radius-md);
  color: var(--chat-text);
}
```

Never key off a skin class: `.chat-skin-terminal` and friends are an internal application mechanism, not a selector surface.

## Stable tokens

These resolve under every skin. Colour tokens follow the active colour scheme on their own.

### anchors

| token | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--chat-panel` | Opaque panel body. The widget reads as this colour. |
| `--chat-glass` | Translucent floating surface (menus, popovers, dialogs). |
| `--chat-sunken` | Recessed surface for code blocks and read-only fields. |
| `--chat-ground` | Deepest ground behind the panel body. |
| `--chat-backdrop` | Modal scrim. Dark in both schemes by convention. |
| `--chat-text` | Primary body ink. |
| `--chat-text-hi` | Emphasis ink for headings and strong text. |
| `--chat-text-2` | Secondary ink for labels and muted prose. |
| `--chat-text-3` | Faint ink for metadata and timestamps. |
| `--chat-fill` | Neutral fill layered over the panel. |
| `--chat-fill-soft` | Lightest neutral fill. |
| `--chat-fill-strong` | Strongest neutral fill, used for hover and active. |
| `--chat-line` | Default hairline. |
| `--chat-line-soft` | Quietest hairline, for internal dividers. |
| `--chat-line-2` | Emphasised hairline, for focused and outer edges. |
| `--chat-accent` | Brand accent. Drives links, focus rings and primary fills. |
| `--chat-on-accent` | Ink placed on an accent fill. |
| `--chat-danger` | Error ink and error borders. |
| `--chat-success` | Success ink and success borders. |
| `--chat-warn` | Warning ink and warning borders. |
| `--chat-dim` | Base colour of the pending and thinking shimmer. |
| `--chat-shadow-sm` | Tight elevation for small controls. |
| `--chat-shadow-lg` | Wide elevation for floating surfaces. |
| `--chat-font` | Body font stack. |
| `--chat-font-display` | Display font stack for titles and rails. |
| `--chat-mono` | Monospace font stack for code, paths and terminals. |
| `--chat-radius-sm` | Inline control radius, smallest step. |
| `--chat-radius-md` | Inline control radius, default step. |
| `--chat-radius-lg` | Inline control radius, largest step. |
| `--chat-radius-chip` | Chip and tag radius. |
| `--chat-radius-pill` | Fully rounded radius for pills and avatars. |
| `--chat-radius-surface-sm` | Floating surface radius, smallest step. |
| `--chat-radius-surface-md` | Floating surface radius, default step. |
| `--chat-radius-surface-lg` | Floating surface radius, largest step. |
| `--chat-ease` | Default easing curve for state changes. |
| `--chat-ease-expo` | Decisive easing curve for entrances and exits. |
| `--chat-space` | Spacing base unit of the conversation surfaces (thread and composer). Stay within roughly 8% of 0.25rem; text sizes ride the font scale and do not shrink with it. |

### derived

| token | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--chat-accent-hi` | accent hover, mixed toward black on light and toward white on dark |
| `--chat-accent-link` | accent links |
| `--chat-accent-08` | accent tint 8% |
| `--chat-accent-20` | accent tint 20% |
| `--chat-accent-line` | accent border |
| `--chat-panel-sunk` | deepest field bg |
| `--chat-agent` | fixed agent hue (teal), darkened toward the ink anchor on light |
| `--chat-danger-line` | error border |
| `--chat-shadow` | elevation |
| `--chat-shadow-hover` | elevation hover |

## Spacing

Spacing utilities (`p-*`, `gap-*`, `m-*`) are stable. Inside the thread and composer they scale with the active skin's `--chat-space`; elsewhere they use the widget default.
